first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: The cyan-blue sky above the ridge and on the image-left side, containing dense points of starlight and a vertical pinkish-white to pinkish-purple bright band.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The dark blue body of water in the lower part of the image, bounded by the mountains on the far shore and the Foreground rocky slope.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark, undulating mountains on the far side of the Lake surface, including the ridgeline and the steep mountain walls descending toward the lakeshore.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The rough, grayish-brown rocky earth slope extending from the image-right side to the lower edge.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The dark thicket with narrow, pointed crowns and layered lateral branches on the top and edge of the foreground slope.

entities.name: Object H
entities.identification: The tiny warm-colored bright point in the sky at the lower left in the initial frame, which later moves toward the upper right and appears as a gradually lengthening diagonal bright line.

entities.name: Hilltop guardrail
entities.identification: A short section of light gray, thin-rod guardrail at the top of the slope in the upper-right corner, with spaced vertical posts and connecting horizontal rails.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: A collection of grayish-white, curved, branching, leafless woody trunks and branches on the foreground slope in the lower part of the image.
